title: Unified benchmark scoring model — Oracle/Mem0/Microsoft standards alignment
description:
Closes the gap identified by comparing gh-pages Run #11 (a pure pytest-benchmark micro-latency report — hashing 2.14µs, metadata filtering 1.7-4µs, bulk insert 1.9s/1000 items) against the three vendors' published benchmark methodologies: Oracle AI Agent Memory reports 93.8% on LongMemEval with ~10.7x token reduction (arXiv 2607.13157); Microsoft's Memora reports 86.3%/87.4% LLM-judge accuracy on LoCoMo/LongMemEval plus STATE-Bench task-success deltas; Mem0's 2026 token-efficient algorithm reports 91.6%/93.4% on LoCoMo/LongMemEval at ~7K tokens/query. This SDK already has the Oracle-shaped performance axis (EPIC-13 pytest-benchmark foundation, EPIC-14 single-op coverage, EPIC-15 Locust concurrency/scale, EPIC-17 CI tiering, EPIC-18 Db2-specific depth) and the Mem0-shaped retrieval-accuracy axis (EPIC-16's real-LongMemEval replacement of the synthetic dataset, EPIC-6's root-caused accuracy-gap findings, EPIC-11's TRU-4 embedding-provider re-run and TRU-5 token-efficiency figure vs. Mem0's number) — but nothing today combines them into one reportable score, and nothing measures the third axis at all (see EPIC-21, the Microsoft Foundry/AutoGen-shaped agent-quality axis this repo has never touched). This epic does not rebuild any of that existing infrastructure; it is the integration layer on top of it.

Three stories: UNI-1 is a research/alignment pass producing a matrix mapping every existing epic onto the vendor axis it corresponds to plus the confirmed gap, landed as a dated DECISIONS.md entry (mirrors the discipline of EPIC-11's 2026-08-04 entry and EPIC-7's 2026-07-31 entry — every prior research-driven epic in this project lands its rationale in DECISIONS.md before or alongside the stories it justifies). UNI-2 defines the actual composite formula. UNI-3 builds the report generator that renders it. Sequenced last on purpose: UNI-3 needs EPIC-21's AGQ-5 output to have a third sub-score to combine, and needs EPIC-19's BM-26/BM-27 reporting rewrite as the document it appends to, not a competing report format. Same Step 0 philosophy as every prior epic: no mandatory new infrastructure, additive-only to BENCHMARKS.md, no CI gate changes beyond what EPIC-17 already defines.
